title: code-names.json: the retired code names, one list (krizaka-internal#4284)
description: Each term is a retired code name with its replacement, its detect regex and its ordered compound forms. A hit of a term outside a history path is a bug. Read by scripts/code-names/lib.mjs, which refuses a list that does not match this schema.

version.description: Semver of the list: a new term or form raises it, so a consumer pinned by commit SHA is bumped through one reviewed change.

term.description: The retired code name, lower case.

replacement.description: The commercial name that replaces it, lower case.

detect.description: The detect regex: a substring match, in any case (flag i).

forms.description: The compound forms, most specific first; the first form that matches a place wins. `to` is a template ($1..$9 are the groups); the case of the term found is kept.

kind.description: What the name is: a slice applies only the kinds it owns.

flags.description: Regex flags: `i` (the default) or none, for a form that is upper case only.

resolve.description: The replacement must be resolved by this service first (a repository URL by the GitHub API).

history.description: Path globs that may keep a name for ever, the only permanent exceptions; central, a repository cannot add one. `<repo>:<glob>` scopes one to a repository.
